jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs_results.company_name: ING BANK NV SUCURSAL EN ESPAÑA
jobs_results.description: At ING we are looking for QA Automation Engineer Your role and work environment: We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic QA Automation Engineer to join our Release Team of Engineering Platform Tribe. The responsibility of this team is enforcing the release process, guaranteeing the feature(s) quality delivered to our customer while reducing our cycle time. Your key responsibilities: As a QA Automation Engineer, you will: Provide regular, detailed status report on project progress, including test cases executed, bugs discovered, and bugs fixed. Pushing the existing test strategy inside the company, through advocacy and leading by example. Develop test plans that approximate real-world environments and tools that assist in product validation. QA Engineers are also responsible for driving the development process toward quality-centric methodologies. What are we looking for? Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this... role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply! Good analytical and communication skills, ability to deliver technical information at all levels within the company. A team player working as a core member of a team. Close collaboration within and across the teams of the tribe. As a QA engineer, you must have: QA methodologies (e.g. shift left, test levels, test types). Experience in defining and designing test plans for acceptance criteria. Ability to automate operational process. Scripting (Python, Bash) Basic knowledge of relational data bases Create, configure and support CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) Write and perform automated tests (functional, system, regression, and integration tests) Experience with Git including branching/merging workflows Knowledge of RESTful APIs Experience working with Public Clouds (Azure, GCP or AWS) Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools. English oral and written communication skills (B2 or higher). What do we offer? The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details. Check out what is waiting for you! Be flexible my friend. Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing. Restaurant card. So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings. Our house will be your home. In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more! Health insurance. For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children). Life insurance. We help you protect what matters most to you. Flexible remuneration. In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids… Free company shuttle. It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably. Banking benefits. Special loans with more beneficial conditions. Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank. And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us! More vitality and more belonging 360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose). Physiotherapy service on site. Runners club with your own trainer. Clinics with professional, world-class athletes. Gympass service. Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+) & Leonas. Get to know Us We are a team of more than 1600 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go. A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies. And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries. We are proud to have a diverse team and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society. And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clints decide to embark on this journey. Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you! We hire people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on more responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. With around 57,000 employees in over 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities. Show us initiative and we’ll let you make a difference. ING is a great place to join. We work in a highly dynamic environment where people are trusted to make decisions and every voice gets heard. If you have an idea how to make things better, you’ll be encouraged to make it happen – regardless of your position. We’d love to meet you

jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
Somos una empresa que gestiona una cartera de más de 200 aplicaciones y juegos móviles, y recientemente alcanzamos el hito de más de 700 millones de descargas y más de 70 millones de usuarios activos mensuales. Nos enfocamos en el crecimiento y el desempeño a gran escala.

Requerimos de incorporación inmediata de un/a QA TESTER JUNIOR.

La oferta es 100% presencial en MADRID

Tareas

El QA Specialist es el encargado de ayudar en la realización de pruebas de calidad del software y en la identificación de posibles errores. Deberá ser capaz de seguir instrucciones y trabajar con el equipo de pruebas y de desarrollo. Realizará labores de documentación y reportes de los resultados de las pruebas en un formato claro y conciso.

El puesto ofrece una excelente oportunidad para crecer profesionalmente y desarrollar habilidades en el campo de las pruebas de software.
• *Responsabilidades**:

- Aseguramiento de la calidad del software
- Verificar la calidad del producto durante y al final del... desarrollo
- Análisis de estrategias, diseño y ejecución integral de pruebas
- Informe detallado a los diferentes departamentos implicados sobre el estado de las solicitudes
• *Requisitos**:
• *Requisitos**:

- 1 año de experiência en pruebas de aplicaciones
- Conocimiento de Android Studio
- Conocimiento en análisis de logs de aplicaciones Android y IOS
- Buenas habilidades comunicativas, tanto orales como escritas
- Un perfil personal muy enfocado al aprendizaje y de carácter curioso. Persona dinámica, colaboradora y resolutiva. Buenas habilidades de trabajo en equipo
- Inglés B2
- Valorable conocimiento de herramientas publicitarias para aplicaciones
- Valorable Conocimientos de programación Python

Beneficios
• *Beneficios**:

- Trabajar en un equipo dinámico y rodeado de profesionales
- Contrato indefinido
- Desarrollo continuo y profesional en la empresa

jobs_results.title: Game Tester: Arabic
jobs_results.description:
Localsoft, S.L. is a world-class localization company offering translation, testing and audio services. From our headquarters in the Málaga TechPark in Málaga, Spain, we operate both locally and internationally with clients from many different business sectors including leading brands in the Games, IT, Legal and Business industries.

We are currently hiring Arabic (MSA) Language Game Testers to work in our HQ in Málaga, Spain.

If you have previous game testing experience or you are an avid gamer with excellent linguistic skills, we would like to hear from you!

As a Game Tester you will be testing games to detect and report grammar, spelling, punctuation and other linguistic and cultural errors in your native language.

Visit: www.localsoftgames.com

Responsibilities
• Follow company policy and values
• Follow established processes, instructions and QA checklists
• Take full ownership of each phase in the project life cycle
• Successfully complete tasks to the highest standards
• Be... aligned with Localsoft’s security and code of conduct
• Willingness to learn and improve, support other team members and go the extra mile

Requirements
• English with full working proficiency.
• Excellent native language skills
• Capacity to work in a multicultural, dynamic and deadline-driven work environment
• Good knowledge of game genres and platforms is a plus
• Good teamwork and interpersonal skills
• Proactive and positive “can do” attitude
• Understanding the importance of quality, customer service, confidentiality and security

Benefits
• Opportunity to work with a professional international team in a dynamic and friendly work environment
• Opportunity to work with renowned clients (publishers/developers)
• Cafeteria & Games
• Soft Drinks
• Fresh Fruit

Additional information
• Valid work permit for Spain is required
• Testing is performed in Localsoft’s secure testing lab in Málaga, Spain
• Remote work is not possible

jobs_results.title: QA ENGINEER / AGILE TESTER
jobs_results.description:
QA Engineer

In HiringIt Spain, we’re looking for a QA Engineer/Agile Tester with around 5 years experience (2 in testing), for a big ecommerce platform with offices in the center of Madrid. Details:

What you will be responsible for
• moving agile testing process forward to ensure and extend the quality of development
• defining acceptance tests (including test scenarios) to show that stories are implemented as expected and drive test automation – to make results highly visible within and outside the team
• improving the existing testing tool chain
• monitoring and reviewing test coverage and ensuring that tests are developed and maintained at a high level of quality
• creating, executing and maintaining automated regression tests
• testing on different platforms, devices and browsers
• working in a motivated IT team for Sales and Marketing/CRM

What we are looking for
• Talented colleagues who enjoy working in an open, creative and ambitious environment.
• As a successful Agile... tester you should have the following skills
• knowledge of BDD and Specification by Example techniques, tools and methods (Cucumber, Gherkin, …)
• ability to create testing data-sets and handle the data-set life cycle (SQL or other query languages for nonrelational databases)
• excellent interpersonal communication skills, highly motivated and proactive
• experience with regression, functional and exploratory testing; managing software test automation
• experience in a web environment – e-commerce preferred
• advanced knowledge of Java
• experience with Scrum or other Agile methodologies
• at least five years of software development experience (with at least two years focused on testing)
• agile tester certification would be an advantage
• English Language skills are required

What we are offering you

Become a part of our success story and seize the opportunity to take on a real challenge in a dynamically growing company where there is huge scope for development and short decision-making processes. We are offering you a versatile, international-facing role in our motivated team with colleagues from all over Europe. Our Spanish office is at a great location in Madrid, with great infrastructure links. Additionally we offer competitive benefits such as medical insurance and many others

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.company_name: ESML SD Iberia Holding S A U
jobs_results.description: Senior QA Engineer– Marketing & Sales Do you want to make an impact every day by keeping people safe - and by bringing them a sense of security and peace of mind? Interested in being part of a dedicated, passionate team that believes that security is a human right? Looking to join a company where innovation and technology are at the heart of its solutions? Join us today! Present in more than 17 countries across Europe and Latin America, Verisure Securitas Direct is a leader specializing in developing products and services in the home security sector. We are an award-winning ‘Internet of Things company, having amassed a ton of experience and expertise for over more than 30 years. Unlike many competitors, we keep most work in-house to guarantee premium quality every step of the way. Our office in Madrid is a top R&D Center in the connected smart home market. Here we create and develop services and products for home security and home automation. We are looking for people who can make a... tangible positive impact in delivering breakthrough innovation in Research & Development to transform and add value, not only to our Company but the industry itself. Main Responsibilities We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who set up and lead the QA strategy for the Marketing and Sales domains in our 17 Countries. Define and implement the test strategy of the Global Marketing and Sales IT department. Align this implementation and tools used with the QA discipline in the company. Collaborate with the discipline with create the best in class QA processes in the company. Define the way of working regarding QA aligned with the product owner, technical lead and scrum master. Lead the execution of this QA strategy and implementation of this way of working in each of the scrum teams aligned with the priorities and situation of each project. Manage performance of the QA test together with the product owners and technical leads of each team (6-7 people). Work together with the Service/Maintenance team, QA team and developers to drive to 0 the bugs in production. Implement a continuous improvement mindset within the QA team and other members of the company with the objective of maximize the quality in production. Improve testing processes like implementation of E2E scenarios which covers critical processes. Define and lead the implementation of the testing automation strategy. Lead the implementation of the device farm project and promote the usage in the company. Build reports to understand the QA situation within the teams. Report status of implementation of the strategy to middle and senior management. Competencies Strategic mindset and leadership skills to lead a team and the implementation of the strategy. 5+ years’ experience leading QA teams 10+ years’ experience in testing Experience with testing plugin in JIRA, Confluence. Experience with devices farm tools (Google, AWS, Saculelabs) Experience with testing automation tools (selenium, webdriver.io, apium) Experience working in international environment Experience managing senior management stakeholders Functional understanding of the marketing and sales business Experience with Agile Methodologies/lean and tools: JIRA, Confluence, etc. Ability to clearly communicate with peers, manager and senior managers Ability to function with new technologies Requirements Education: Master/ B.A in Computer Engineer or Telecommunications English B2 Other Competencies: Service culture, continuous improvement mindset Critical thinking and problem solving abilities to address complex issues involving data movement and data replication Proactive and dynamic person Must be a self-starter as well as a good team player. Good communication skills. Leadership skills to help technical lead with the team motivation to learn new methodologies. We Offer Passion for our People We believe that we make a difference every day. To do that, we need committed and engaged employees. Our people are accountable for delivering world-class service and they are passionate about making the world a safer and more secure place. Our teams operate with integrity and respect for one another fueled by an entrepreneurial spirit. We are building a high-performance organization through investing in our people with great development and growth opportunities. We also offer hybrid working model. Passion for Innovation We are a growth company. Our continuous investment in innovation has led to consistent top and bottom-line growth. The more we grow, the safer the world becomes. Our Investors We are owned by a leading private equity firm: Hellman & Friedman. Our sponsor has invested in our innovation pipeline and in our organization to fuel our accelerated growth and play a leading role in the industry. We are Verisure – and we are Proud to Protect Verisure is the leading provider of professionally-monitored smart alarms for residential households and small businesses in Europe, and we are growing in Latin America. We trade as Verisure in most of the countries where we operate, and as Securitas Direct in Spain and Portugal. We protect more than three million customers in 16 countries. Our business model integrates product development, design and sales with installation, outstanding service and a 24/7 professional monitoring solution. We protect people from intrusion, fire and flood - and we save lives. We believe it is a human right to feel safe and secure. It takes passionate people to protect Protecting what matters most for our customers takes innovative technology and, above all, passionate people. People who are driven by our purpose. Every one of our 17,000 colleagues takes this responsibility to protect seriously. Every day, they demonstrate our DNA – the unique imprint we look for, nurture and unleash in every member of our Verisure family. Our people strategy is clear: to create the best, winning team. We do this by finding and attracting the very best talent; by growing and nurturing the talent we already have; and by engaging our people around our vision, our strategy and our DNA. And with more than 80% of our colleagues interacting with our customers every day, they personally deliver our customer promise: to protect what matters most. Do you have what it takes to be Proud to Protect? Would you like to be part of the next phase of our successful growth story? We are looking forward to receive your application

jobs_results.title: QA Senior Tester
jobs_results.description:
¡Atención QA testers apasionados por el aprendizaje y la innovación!

¿Te apasiona el aprendizaje continuo y el diseño de experiencias que inspiren y motiven? ¡Entonces esta es tu oportunidad para sobresalir!

Con nuestra experiencia técnica avanzada y visión futurista, estamos liderando el cambio y buscamos a personas como tú, que estén listas para desafiar los límites y ser parte de algo más grande.

¡No pierdas la oportunidad de formar parte de nuestro equipo y dejar tu huella en la industria de la calidad de software!
• Lo que te ofrecemos**
• Flexibilidad Total: Organiza tu día como prefieras, ¡tu tiempo es tuyo!
• Trabajo Remoto: Trabaja desde donde te sientas más cómodo, sin ataduras a una oficina.
• Crecimiento Versátil: Aprende nuevos idiomas y explora diversos sectores con nuestra Expleo Academy.
• Tiempo para Ti: Disfruta de 24 días de vacaciones al año, más los días 24 y 31 de diciembre.
• Ambiente Inmejorable: Un lugar donde el apoyo entre compañeros es la norma y la... competitividad no tiene cabida.
• Conexión y Bienestar: Únete a nuestro club de pádel y running para mantenernos activos y conectados.
• Beneficios Flexibles: Seguro médico, cheques restaurante y guardería, ¡tú eliges cómo usarlos!
• ¿Qué te hará triunfar en esta posición?**
• Experiencia mínima de 5 años en un rol similar.
• Experiencia variada en pruebas: Tu sólida experiencia en una amplia gama de pruebas, desde rendimiento hasta estrés, te proporcionará las herramientas necesarias para abordar cualquier desafío en el aseguramiento de la calidad del software.
• Maestría en herramientas de seguimiento de errores: Tu habilidad avanzada en herramientas como JIRA te permitirá no solo detectar problemas, sino también gestionarlos de manera eficiente, asegurando una resolución rápida y efectiva.
• Dominio de múltiples sistemas operativos: Tu familiaridad con sistemas como Linux/Unix y Windows te otorgará la versatilidad necesaria para llevar a cabo pruebas en una variedad de entornos, garantizando así una cobertura exhaustiva.
• Especialización en pruebas de servicios web: Tu experiencia en pruebas de servicios web y el manejo de herramientas como SOAP UI, JMeter y Postman te convertirán en un experto en evaluar la funcionalidad y el rendimiento de las aplicaciones basadas en web.
• Fluidez en inglés: Tu nivel avanzado de inglés te permitirá comunicarte sin problemas en un entorno profesional internacional y colaborar efectivamente con equipos distribuidos globalmente.
• Habilidad de liderazgo y planificación: Tu historial de liderar equipos y participar en la planificación de proyectos te prepara para dirigir con éxito las actividades de prueba y garantizar la entrega puntual de proyectos de alta calidad.
• Comunicación efectiva: Tu capacidad para comunicar de manera clara y elaborar informes detallados te permitirá transmitir los resultados de las pruebas de manera efectiva y colaborar de manera productiva con otros equipos.
• Enfoque en el cliente y adaptabilidad: Tu orientación hacia el cliente y tu capacidad para adaptarte a entornos dinámicos te asegurarán de satisfacer las necesidades cambiantes del cliente y entregar soluciones de calidad excepcional.
• Certificación ISQTB: Tu certificación ISQTB demuestra tu compromiso con la excelencia en el aseguramiento de la calidad del software y añade un valor adicional a tu perfil profesional.
• Tu misión en el puesto**

Planificación y Calendario:
• Desarrollar la estrategia de validación y los planes de prueba con la innovadora metodología DDQS.
• Interactuar directamente con los clientes para comprender sus necesidades y expectativas.
• Crear y gestionar el calendario de validación, identificando riesgos y proponiendo soluciones.
• Generar informes detallados y realizar un seguimiento de los indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para asegurar la calidad del proceso.

Ejecución:
• Realizar pruebas exhaustivas de productos y componentes, siguiendo rigurosamente los protocolos establecidos.
• Colaborar activamente con los equipos de desarrollo para resolver rápidamente cualquier problema identificado.
• Diseñar una estrategia integral de integración y ejecutar pruebas de extremo a extremo en una escala global.
• Coordinar eficazmente con diversos equipos y presentar informes claros para cumplir con los plazos.

Participación Internacional:
• Contribuir al plan de pruebas de aceptación y apoyar en su despliegue, integración y aceptación en el sitio del cliente, lo que puede requerir viajes internacionales.

Esta emocionante posición te desafiará y te permitirá destacarte en un entorno dinámico y en constante evolución.

“Somos una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y aceptamos solicitudes de todas las personas debidamente calificadas, independientemente de su raza, sexo, discapacidad, religión/creencia, orientación sexual o edad”
